verdict.rationale: mParticle documents several public APIs: direct event ingestion over HTTP, a Warehouse Sync API, a Platform Audiences API, and a real-time API for personalization. Together these let a user or agent drive ingestion, audiences and warehouse sync programmatically. Missing for 10: most evidence is page titles without API-reference depth (auth, endpoints, coverage of configuration and management tasks), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of using the APIs.
